resources.string: Run the phone from the charger and stop charging the battery. The firmware only holds the battery at 80% or above.
Enforcing. Changes apply at once and persist across reboots.
Permissive. Changes apply at once and persist across reboots.

Permissive mode disables Android\'s security policy. Apps and services are no longer confined, so a compromised app can access data and hardware it normally cannot. This setting stays on across reboots until you turn enforcing back on.
